steps.title: Prepare qRT‑PCR reaction
steps.instruction: Set up a one‑step qRT‑PCR using the SuperScript™ III Platinum™ One‑Step qRT‑PCR Kit (Life Technologies, Catalog #11732088) according to the manufacturer’s instructions for each sample.

steps.title: Run thermal cycling program
steps.instruction: Program the real‑time PCR instrument with the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: 60 °C for 30 sec (annealing/extension) with fluorescence acquisition at the end of each 60 °C step.

steps.title: Interpret amplification results
steps.instruction: Analyze the fluorescence curves to determine whether each reaction is positive, negative, or invalid.

substeps.instruction: A satisfactory positive result must display a sigmoidal amplification curve that:
– rises exponentially after the initial horizontal baseline,
– reaches a clear transition (TP) and then a plateau (PP) phase.
The fluorescence intensity must be above that of the positive control (y‑axis).
The threshold (C_T) crossing point must occur before cycle 40; a C_T ≥ 40 cycles is considered negative.
No‑template controls (NTCs) must not produce any amplification curve.
TP – transition phase where amplification slows,
PP – plateau phase with little or no increase in signal.
